The remaining 100.00 is not itemized in any document, so it is added to the blinds/repair line at lower confidence. The paint line matches five invoice items exactly. The two cleaning lines are labeled 'per lease - pets' (a lease-mandated pet cleaning, not described as pet damage), so they are cleaning and carpet_cleaning with pet_related=true. The ledger shows a 12/12/23 maintenance charge of 300.00 (freezer) that was credited back 1/10/24, and a 220 late fee waived 1/10/24, both net zero. All rent was paid through 2/2024, and the final payment on 2/18/24 included a 220 late fee. SDRP fee of 43 is paid monthly. Deposit of 2,200 per lease was never collected ('Deposit Paid 0.00'), so the waived amount is inferred.
